proposed_widenings.name: TemplatedCapacity.spellcasting_ability_modifier
proposed_widenings.justification: The SRD says capacity = 'your spellcasting ability modifier', which is class-dependent (CHA for Bard/Sorcerer, INT for Wizard). TemplatedCapacity requires a specific Ability, making it impossible to represent the spell-class-neutral capacity without hardcoding one ability and being wrong for all other classes.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The maximum number of objects is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier

notes: The templated_multi_spawn family fits Animate Objects structurally — capacity, size tiers (HP + slam damage per tier), concentration duration, bonus-action control, and revertOnZeroHp all encode correctly. The only gap is TemplatedCapacity needing a { kind: 'spellcasting_ability_modifier' } variant instead of a hardcoded Ability. Encoded as 'cha' (valid for Bard/Sorcerer); incorrect for Wizard (INT). All size tiers (tiny/small/medium/large/huge) encoded with correct weights (1/1/1/2/3), HP (10/10/10/20/40), and per-tier slam damage with slot-axis upcast scaling. Large/Huge slam correctly uses spellcastingMod: true for the +mod damage component.
